scoring_justification: T1 'recompute' is infeasible because the checker cannot redo the full DFT computation; the task only requires verifying the relative ordering of formation energies (a structural property). This is a legitimate structural_audit, as the paper's main claim about stability is expressed as an ordering.

outputs.description: Formation energies for Cd substitutional, interstitial, and Cd+O2 vacancy complexes. The checker will verify the relative ordering: formation_energy(Cd_s) > formation_energy(Cd_I) > formation_energy(Cd_I^{VO2}) > formation_energy(^{VO2}Cd_I^{VO2}) (strict ordering required).

output_contract.notes: Only the formation energy ordering is scored; absolute values may differ due to code/pseudopotential differences. The agent must compute all four configurations; missing entries or a wrong ordering results in zero credit.

steps.description: Verify that all four configurations are present and their formation energies obey the strict inequality: E(Cd_s) > E(Cd_I) > E(Cd_I^{VO2}) > E(^{VO2}Cd_I^{VO2}).
